issue: Idle/pending peek alone has a check/use race if a new dispatcher request starts before context disposal.
fix: Replace observational may_dispose with an exclusive finish_host operation; invalidate and detach the local context under the same busy guard. Concurrent busy responses use pending255 unknown without dereferencing the context. No device close is performed.
verification: Fake watcher invokes finish_host while the real fake native call is blocked; it must return PENDING without invalidation. Parent/thread exit and normal process tests rerun against the changed sources.
